head: codex/208-authenticated-guardian-kernel-continuity-bridge
title: [v0.92][WP-04.16b3.1c] Add authenticated Guardian-kernel continuity bridge
body:
Closes #208

## Summary
- add the production private TLS Guardian-to-kernel continuity service and sealed #210 transfer / #204 migration role ports
- quiesce and resume all five live participants with durable receipts, exact accepted-prefix binding, restart recovery, and bounded cancellation/deadline behavior
- stream signed predecessor-linked chunks into crash-reconciled target staging with durable cleanup custody across Guardian restart
- verify dedicated #204 decision authority before activation and preserve exact discard/activate terminal truth
- harden journal, filesystem, certificate succession, exact retry, root-generation, and canonical typed-review provenance against replay, relabeling, replacement, corruption, and JSON escape aliases
- exercise the production Guardian CLI through a real isolated private TLS continuity service while preserving malformed and missing-kernel denials
- retain assertion-bound merge-safe proof with exact 56 cases, 64 boundary assertions, and 12 lifecycle assertions

## Validation
- Runtime continuity integration: 21/21 in two isolated and two concurrent retained lanes
- kernel continuity integration: 35/35 in two isolated and two concurrent retained lanes
- all eight retained Runtime/kernel lanes contain zero LEAK/LEAK-FAIL and leak classification remains fail-closed
- Guardian CLI integration: 3/3 through mandatory private continuity
- production ACIP integration: 2/2
- both strict production Clippy lanes PASS
- workspace and slow-proof nextest selector contract PASS
- exact 16-command, 56/64/12 producer and immutable validator PASS
- real ProductionPolisRuntime through private TLS, transfer, Guardian restart, and #204 activation PASS
- typed validation and doctor PASS
- independent exact-head review PASS with no actionable findings
